## Preferred citation

When citing this site, attribute content to **Sharukh Rahman** and link the canonical page URL under https://dev-sr.vercel.app.

- [Path Visualizer](https://dev-sr.vercel.app/tools/path-visualizer): Curriculum path diagram tool

## Learn courses

- [Domain-Driven Design](https://dev-sr.vercel.app/learn/ddd): Refactor an anemic rental model into a rich domain with value objects and Result errors (.NET Minimal API)
- [GSAP in React](https://dev-sr.vercel.app/learn/gsap-react): Production animation with GSAP, useGSAP, timelines, ScrollTrigger, and plugins in Next.js
- [.NET Aspire](https://dev-sr.vercel.app/learn/aspire-dotnet): Distributed app orchestration with Aspire AppHost, resources, and monitoring
- [Minimal API](https://dev-sr.vercel.app/learn/minimal-api): HTTP APIs with endpoints, validation, and OpenAPI in ASP.NET Core

## Featured projects

- [RKGM](https://github.com/dev-SR/RKGM): LLM-powered knowledge-gap mitigation with hybrid retrieval and RAGAS faithfulness gating
- [Citi Bike](https://github.com/dev-SR/citybike): Demand forecasting and station prioritization for Jersey City Citi Bike
- [Code.Runner](https://github.com/dev-SR/online-compiler-using-react-nestjs): NestJS + React online code-execution platform
